description: Multi-service selection (MCPWARP.md §4.8 row 3b): the Host label c-svc-alice names c-svc, which this agent does not hold, so no service is selected and the request is answered 503 {"error":"service unavailable"} without calling any handler. Selection comes after the path check: the same Host with a path other than /mcp is a 404 (multi_service_unknown_service_non_mcp_404).
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: c-svc-alice.tunnel.example
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 31

{"error":"service unavailable"}
notes: A selected service answers its own 503 when it cannot serve: service disabled for a dashboard-disabled one (row 3d), service unavailable for a locally disabled, rejected, unregistered or never-active one (row 3e).
